# Runbook: what to do when X happens

- Applies to: (component, environment)
- Last verified: YYYY-MM-DD (by actually following it)
- Severity guide: (what makes this urgent)

## Symptoms

How you recognise this situation: alerts, error messages, dashboard panels, user reports.

## Immediate safe actions

Numbered steps that reduce harm quickly and are safe to run without understanding the cause.

## Diagnosis

Where to look and what each finding means. Commands are copy-pasteable.

## Fix

Steps to restore normal service, and how to confirm it worked.

## Rollback

How to undo the fix or the change that caused the problem.

## Afterwards

- Write a short incident note (what happened, impact, cause, fix, prevention) in `docs/runbooks/incidents/`.
- Open issues for follow-ups. Update this runbook if it was wrong or incomplete.
